team.official_roster_note: National-meet Power uses a 15-person team. The separate mail/in-school Power Contest has a dedicated Rules page marked Under Construction and does not establish a current official roster on the archived pages. This card therefore keeps an unresolved 2–15 active range and defaults to 15.
team.collaboration: Contestants collaborate only with teammates on one shared proof packet. This card does not claim a complete current Power Contest administrivia package.

human_constraints: Treat this sitting as a team Power proof packet, not as a complete current ARML Power Contest administrivia package.
The dedicated Power Contest Rules page is published as Under Construction; do not invent a sit clock, official roster, computational-aid exception, or mail/in-school window from that missing packet.

Where published national ARML Power rules are the only available Power constraints, the packet is worth 50 points and the team may file exactly one solution; extra solutions are all scored and the lowest is kept.
Write proofs or justifications, not only final numbers, matching the verbs on the packet.
Calculators are not allowed on any published ARML part; do not grant a Power Contest calculator or computer-algebra exception the pages do not give.
Electronic devices, internet, books, and outside help are forbidden; paper and pencil only.
Collaborate only with teammates on one shared packet.
Do not look up hidden solutions or contest archives.
rules_text: This sitting is a team Power proof packet. It is not a complete current ARML Power Contest administrivia package: the dedicated Rules page is Under Construction, and you must not invent a sit clock, official roster, or computational-aid exception. Where published national ARML Power rules are the only available Power constraints, the packet is worth 50 points and the team files exactly one solution; extra packets are all scored and the lowest is kept. Write the justifications the verbs require. Calculators and electronic devices are banned; paper and pencil only; no internet, books, or outside help. Do not treat a list of bare answers as a complete Power packet. Treat unexposed physical, oral, live-opponent, judge, timing, or environment mechanisms as unavailable rather than simulated facts.
